'''Jaren''' was the son of [[Adan]] and [[Siedre]].

== History ==
At aged nineteen, he killed himself by jumping off a cliff when he found he could channel, shortly after the breaking.{{ref/book|4|26}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jaren|comp}}

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until decades after his death. He should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
